serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Listen everyone! That Priestbot has a gun! So, fuck off!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That wasn’t necessary Shanice. They are leaving. How am I supposed to convert them now?
Shanice: Shut up! You can do that later.
Bot: Ecclesiasticalot FF, what does ‘colon praying underscore hands colon’ mean? You are ending your every message with it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s an emote, child. Don’t tell me… You can’t read emotes? Download a plugin.
Shanice: Ugh! 
Shanice: For some reason the knowledge that Priestcan is using emojis is making me want to puke.
Shanice: Also, stop trying to convert her in private chat, you creep.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Sorry, I’m just doing my job. You should try it sometimes.
You: Are we getting closer to the place?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes, we are very close now to the coordinates Shanice gave me. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Wait a minute…{{wi}} Something is not right.
Shanice: What? What’s the problem?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There’s a hidden camera there. It’s pointing in the direction of the coordinates.
Bot: How did you find it? My sensors are not picking anything up.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s a small electronic device that is communicating through ultra low frequency. This kind of thing is completely invisible to you. 
Bot: Anon, buy me an ultra low frequency secure communication module.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That's military-grade equipment, you know? I doubt he can get his hands on something like that. Let me hook you up with my guy from the Vatican, I bought a whole bunch of rocket launchers and other things from him.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Sure!
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: Don’t do it Priestbot, we don’t need that stuff.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Sure, I understand. Sorry for meddling in.
You: It’s fine.
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
#bot.Expression.Happy
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceHappy(instant)
You: You sent it to her in a private message, didn’t you?
#Priestbot.Face.botFacePeaceful(instant)
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Anyway, there’s no way of tracking the signal of that camera, but whoever was on the receiving end isn’t further than 5 miles from this point.
You: That close? Good thing you found it. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Someone was really interested in this place.
Shanice: So let’s get in and do our search as fast as possible, come on!
